name: nitrosend
description: AI email marketing in Cursor and Grok. Ask your agent to build an email Brand Kit from your website, then write, design and send newsletters, email campaigns, automated email flows (welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back) and transactional emails, and reply from a shared inbox. Import contacts from Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo or any CSV, and connect Shopify, HubSpot and Attio. Hosted MCP server, OAuth sign-in, no API key, free to start.
